{{Historical content}} {{Event content}} {{Multiple choice|You can either spread the vaccine and complete this quest, or kill [[Sanitar]] and complete [[Forgotten Oaths]] from [[Jaeger]].}} {{Infobox quest |icon = |image =DontBelieveYourEyesBanner.png |location =[[Lighthouse]], [[Shoreline]], [[Woods]], [[Customs]], [[Factory]], [[The Lab]] |given by =[[Therapist]] |reward = |reputation = |quest number = |previous =[[Darkest Hour Is Just Before Dawn]] |leads to = |related =[[Forgotten Oaths]] |related2 = |reqkappa =No }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|The vaccine you found is a real treasure! With the help of my former TerraGroup colleague, we managed to finalize the formula. Unfortunately, administering the drug is fatal along with neutralizing the virus. This is the only way we can save those who have not yet been affected by this terrible disease... The best place to distribute the drug is in the water supply. Dissolve it at the designated points and come back. I'll give you the recipe in case something happens to the doses you're receiving now.}} ==Objectives== * Spread the [[TG-Vi-24 lethal vaccine|vaccine]] on [[Lighthouse]] * Spread the [[TG-Vi-24 lethal vaccine|vaccine]] on [[Shoreline]] * Spread the [[TG-Vi-24 lethal vaccine|vaccine]] on [[Woods]] * Spread the [[TG-Vi-24 lethal vaccine|vaccine]] on [[Customs]] * Spread the [[TG-Vi-24 lethal vaccine|vaccine]] on [[Factory]] * Spread the [[TG-Vi-24 lethal vaccine|vaccine]] on [[The Lab]] ==Rewards== * +70,000 [[EXP]] * [[Therapist]] Rep '''+0.15''' * 200,000 Roubles ** 210,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 230,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 1× [[Item case]] * 3× [[3-(b-TG) stimulant injector]] * 3× [[Trimadol stimulant injector]] * 3× [[SJ6 TGLabs combat stimulant injector]] * Unlocks achievement [[Achievements#Event_achievements|Fatal Outcome]] {{quote|You made the right choice. I know Jaeger tried to trick you into harming my colleague. But I assure you that this version of the drug was the safest way to cleanse the city of the virus...}} ==Failure Penalty== * [[Jaeger]] Rep '''-0.15''' {{quote|How dare you! My colleague made a critical contribution to saving the city and did not deserve this fate! I don't know how I can trust you after such outrageous actions.}} ==Initial Equipment== Unlocks craft for [[TG-Vi-24 lethal vaccine]] at [[Hideout#Modules|Medstation level 2]]. {|class="wikitable" !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !Notes |- |[[File:TG-Vi-24 lethal vaccine Icon.png|link=TG-Vi-24 lethal vaccine]] |[[TG-Vi-24 lethal vaccine]] |6 |Required |Has to be spread. |} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- |[[File:TG-Vi-24 lethal vaccine Icon.png|link=TG-Vi-24 lethal vaccine]] |[[TG-Vi-24 lethal vaccine]] |6 |Required !N/A |Has to be stashed. |} In this quest you have to spread (stash) the [[TG-Vi-24 lethal vaccine]] in the following locations: ====Lighthouse Vaccine Spot==== In the water around the dilapidated village on the eastern island.
